title: StrainQC-nf pipeline parameters
description: Sequencing-based strain QC: variant calling (breseq or GATK), aneuploidy calling (CNVkit) and contamination screening (Kraken2 / MASH).

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Reads, reference genome and where to write results.

input.description: Samplesheet (CSV) listing the samples and their FASTQ files.
input.help_text: Columns: `sample,fastq_1,fastq_2` (leave `fastq_2` empty for single-end). Sample ids must be unique; they name each sample's output folder. FASTQ paths may be absolute, URLs, or relative to the samplesheet.

reference.description: Reference genome, GenBank (preferred: gene annotation) or FASTA.
reference.help_text: A GenBank file lets results report the gene and product hit by each variant and powers the genome browser's annotation track.

outdir.description: Output directory; one folder per sample, each with a results.json.

variant_calling_options.title: Variant calling
variant_calling_options.description: Choose the variant caller and its basic mode.

variant_caller.description: breseq (bacteria, rich mutation reports) or GATK (any genome size, e.g. yeast).

polymorphism_mode.description: Call mixed populations: breseq polymorphism mode, or GATK Mutect2 instead of HaplotypeCaller.

ploidy.description: Genome copies per cell, GATK HaplotypeCaller only (1 = haploid, 2 = diploid yeast).

cnv_options.title: Aneuploidy (CNVkit)
cnv_options.description: Copy-number and whole-chromosome aneuploidy calling against an ancestor (GATK route).

parent_sample.description: Sample id of the un-evolved ancestor. Enables CNVkit: every other sample is called against it.
parent_sample.help_text: Must match a `sample` in the samplesheet; the run stops if it does not. Leave empty to skip CNV calling. Only used with `variant_caller = gatk`.

breseq_options.title: breseq advanced options
breseq_options.description: Fine-tuning for the breseq route; the defaults suit most bacterial resequencing runs.

breseq_limit_fold_coverage.description: Downsample to this fold coverage to save time (0 = no limit).

breseq_min_mapping_quality.description: Ignore reads below this mapping quality.

breseq_polymorphism_frequency_cutoff.description: Lowest allele frequency reported in polymorphism mode.

breseq_consensus_min_cov_each_strand.description: Minimum reads per strand to call a consensus mutation.

breseq_targeted_sequencing.description: Reads come from targeted (not whole-genome) sequencing.

gatk_min_mapping_quality.description: Ignore reads below this mapping quality.

gatk_max_reads_per_align_start.description: Cap reads starting at one position (limits PCR-duplicate pile-ups).

gatk_call_conf.description: Minimum confidence to call a variant (HaplotypeCaller).

gatk_callable_depth.description: Minimum depth for a site to count as callable (Mutect2).

contamination_options.title: Contamination screening
contamination_options.description: Reference databases for detecting contaminating organisms. Each screen is skipped if its database is not given.

kraken2_db.description: Kraken2 database directory (classifies reads that do not map to the reference).

mash_db.description: MASH sketch file, e.g. refseq.msh (identifies dominant and contaminating strains).

run_blast.description: Fallback remote BLAST search when no Kraken2 database is given (slow, needs internet).

evidence_options.title: Read-evidence pre-compute
evidence_options.description: Read pile-ups saved per variant for the web app's evidence viewer.

evidence_window.description: Bases shown either side of each variant.

resource_options.title: Resource limits
resource_options.description: Upper bounds for any single task; set these to the largest machine available.

max_time.description: Maximum run time per task, e.g. '48.h'.

infrastructure_options.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure_options.description: Container image and site-specific HPC settings.

strainqc_container.description: All-in-one tool image. The default is the published image for this release; a local .sif also works with Apptainer.

hpc_pre_command.default: module load miniconda3 ; module load breseq ; eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)" ; conda activate bio-platform ; module load gatk/4.4.0.0 bwa-mem2/2.2.1
hpc_pre_command.description: Shell run before each task under the `hpc_modules` profile (loads tools via environment modules).
